semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: General guidance on the content and scope of Employer's Requirements, specifically referencing Sub-Clauses and technical information.

semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: This node serves as the primary semantic anchor for the section detailing what must be included in the Employer's Requirements. It establishes the context for the subsequent table by defining the logical basis (Sub-Clauses) for the items listed therein.

semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: A single cell within a table header row, acting as a label for the data column that follows.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: This node functions as a structural metadata element (a column header).
